title: The edit-mode part lookup returns the held inactive part and refuses bad ids
custom_preconds: Admin token. Inactive part P1 held on a WO part request.
custom_steps:
1. GET .../inventory-parts-as-options-with-remaining-catalogue-parts?inventoryPartId=<P1 id>&search=
  2. Same with inventoryPartId=abc
  3. Same with a random UUID
  4. Same with a sibling location's part id
custom_expected:
1. 200 with P1 (is_active false)
  2. 400
  3. 404 "Part not found."
  4. 200 without that part
